description: Wave 4D strictly read-only console-only clean-room probe catalog covering open-PR and merged-PR NVSE/extender/vanilla edge-case hypotheses.

batches.title: Wave 4D Batch 1 - Open-PR High-Priority Edge Cases

probes.claim: TagSkills menu opened via SetTagSkills 3 (menu 1048) sets IsInCharGen.
probes.expected: PR #3730 (nvse_jip2.rs:106-109) checks only LOVE_TESTER (1074) || TRAITS (1084), excluding TagSkills.

probes.claim: HasActionRef before/after Activate on unscripted door, scripted front door, sitting/spawned actors, and container.
probes.expected: PR #3732 (nvse_unlisted2.rs:371-379) only checks live ctx.action_ref / action_refs / furniture_use / scripted DOOR base.
script_lines: PrintToConsole "PROBE|w4d_02_has_action_ref_triggers|front=%g|unscr(%i:%g->%g)|doc=%g|spawn=%g|cont(%i:%g->%g)" hF0 rUnscr hU0 hU1 hD0 hS0 rCont hC0 hC1

probes.claim: Truthiness of bare empty/non-empty string literals vs initialized empty/non-empty string_var in if eval.
probes.expected: PR #3691 treats all empty strings or all string_vars uniformly without distinguishing bare "" literal from allocated empty string_var.
script_lines: PrintToConsole "PROBE|w4d_03_eval_empty_str_lit|lit0=%g,lit1=%g|c0=%g,c1=%g|v0=%g,v1=%g" eL0 eL1 eC0 eC1 eV0 eV1

probes.claim: GenericAddForm/Replace/Delete behavior on negative indices (-1, -2, -3, -10) and past-end index on empty and non-empty FLST.
probes.expected: PR #3719 (nvse_lists.rs:183-201) accepts -2 on empty list in Add, rejects -2 in Replace, and rejects all negative indices in Delete.
script_lines: PrintToConsole "PROBE|w4d_04_generic_form_neg_idx|n0=%g|add(-1=%g,-2=%g:%g,-3=%g,oob=%g)|rep(-1=%i,-2=%i)|del(-1=%i:%g,oob=%i)" nInit aNeg1 aNeg2 nA2 aNeg3 aOob rpNeg1 rpNeg2 dlNeg1 nD1 dlOob

probes.claim: Whether 1-arg reference syntax `Player.HasKeyword "TestKW"` compiles in JIP LN 57.30 vs 2-arg `HasKeyword Player "TestKW"`.
probes.expected: PR #3654 (nvse_jip2.rs:304, knvse-anim-folders.md:124) adds 1-arg reference syntax `ref.HasKeyword "keyword"` as [hypothesis].

probes.claim: Whether Player.SetPersistent 0 clears Player.IsPersistent or is ignored on FormId::PLAYER_REF.
probes.expected: PR #3706 (nvse_gaps.rs:999) filters out FormId::PLAYER_REF and ignores attempts to clear Player's persistent flag.

probes.claim: Whether SetCombatDisabled 1 suppresses new combat entry via StartCombat Player on a non-combat actor.
probes.expected: PR #3717 hypothesizes SetCombatDisabled 1 suppresses new combat entry while keeping active combat running.

script_lines: PrintToConsole "PROBE|w4d_07_setcombatdisabled_new_combat|c0=%g,cd(%g->%g->%g),sameTick=%g,nextTick=%g" c0 cd0 cd1 cd2 c1 c2

probes.claim: ForceWeaponJamAnim on static non-actor door, drawn melee weapon (Baseball Bat), and drawn 10mm Pistol with ToggleGodMode active.
probes.expected: PR #3632 (nvse_showoff.rs:440-470) rejects non-actors and melee (anim_type not in 3..=9) and allows TGM.

script_lines: PrintToConsole "PROBE|w4d_08_forcejam_melee_god_nonactor|door=%g|melee(ret=%g,act=%g)|tgm10mm(ret=%g,act=%g)" jDr jBat aBat jTgm aTgm

probes.claim: Crippled right/left/both arm spread penalties across weapon animation types 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, and 10.
probes.expected: PR #3736 (nvse_showoff4.rs:88-94) uses 0.4 fallback for 2H both-arms and includes anim 10..=13 in 1H arm penalties.

probes.claim: Self-referential array a[0] = a passed to Ar_DeepCopy in xNVSE 6.4.9.
probes.expected: NVForever guards against cyclic Ar_DeepCopy to avoid stack overflow.

probes.claim: CompileScript and GetUDFFromFile reject absolute drive paths, extended UNC paths, and parent-directory traversal.
probes.expected: NVForever rejects absolute/drive/stream/traversal paths and returns 00000000.
script_lines: PrintToConsole "PROBE|w4d_11_compilescript_abs_drive|abs(%i,%i)|unc(%i,%i)|trav(%i,%i)" cAbs uAbs cUnc uUnc cTrav uTrav

probes.claim: GetAnimSequenceFrequency on Player KF path and static door before/after wildcard and specific SetAnimSequenceFrequency.
probes.expected: PR #3734 returns -1 for un-published/actor KF sequences and ignores '*' as a query name.
script_lines: PrintToConsole "PROBE|w4d_12_anim_seq_freq_active|door(open=%.2f,star=%.2f,o2=%.2f)|pl(kf0=%.2f,star=%.2f)" dOpen0 dOpenStar dOpen2 pIdle0 pIdleStar

probes.claim: Whether GetHitBaseWeaponDamage on an outdoor distance-attenuated explosion includes distance falloff or returns un-attenuated base damage 100.0.
probes.expected: PR #3689 (combat.rs, jip-hit-info.md:127) returns un-attenuated explosion base damage or leaves distance falloff [hypothesis].

nvseprobe_h_hit13c.gek: PrintToConsole "PROBE|w4d_13_explosion_falloff_outdoor|tag=%g,d=%.1f,bd=%.2f,hd=%.2f,fl8=%g" iTag dist bd hd fl8

probes.claim: Script Runner ordering across gr_, ln_, gn_ prefixes and within-prefix ordering.
probes.expected: PR #3706 (script_runner.rs:160-162) runs ln_ before gn_/gl_, then gr_ after, sorted case-insensitively alphabetically within each prefix.

probes.claim: AddNewEffect return index and order for append=0 (prepend), append=1 (duplicate MGEF), and non-MGEF.
probes.expected: PR #3683 (nvse_jip14.rs:418) returns 0.0 when append=0 (prepend).

probes.claim: Non-empty GetDetectingActors and GetFollowers with SetPlayerTeammate 1 on spawned actors.
probes.expected: GetDetectingActors returns detecting actors; GetFollowers requires an active Follow AI package (not merely SetPlayerTeammate).

probes.claim: ToggleImmortalMode with -1, 3, 99, omitted; whether mode 3 holds HP.
probes.expected: PR #3683 (nvse_jip9.rs:398) stores raw signed i64 (`m as i64`) so -1 reads back as -1 instead of 255.

probes.claim: GetMenuItemFilter 1002 (InventoryMenu) default and persistence across open/close/reopen.
probes.expected: InventoryMenu filter defaults to 1 and is retained after menu close.

probes.claim: GetBarterPriceMult / SetBarterPriceMult inside live BarterMenu (1053), after close, and reset on fresh trade reopen.
probes.expected: PR #3683 hypothesizes SetBarterPriceMult applies to the open trade only and a new trade starts from the rules.

probes.claim: GetCellWaterHeight on interior cell, loaded Goodsprings exterior (no XCLW), and unloaded Camp Golf exterior water cell (0xDDEDC).
probes.expected: PR #3683 hypothesizes a cell without XCLW falls back to worldspace DNAM default water height (and reads unloaded exterior XCLW).

probes.claim: Whether a second AttachLight on the same node replaces or appends to the first attached light.
probes.expected: PR #3683 (ext-unlisted-commands.md:65) hypothesizes one light per node (second AttachLight replaces first).

probes.expected: PR #3683 hypothesizes 0 for a script-declared variable and 1 for added/duplicate dynamic variables.

probes.expected: PR #3683 (nvse_jip12.rs:733-734) deduplicates via BTreeSet (`once each`).
